Ships in an elegant colored printed box that is perfect for gift giving. Give that someone special in your life something that they will definitely enjoy
Beautiful addition to any cafe, restaurant, pub and definitely to your own home. Can be used for Capucinno cups, Lungo cups, Macchiato, Latte, Espresso cups, Demitasse cups, Tea, smoothie and juice.
